title: Exobiopharma
blurb: A visual identity that carries a biopharmaceutical brand from the lab bench to the shelf - wordmark, palette and type system built to stay scientific without going sterile.

sections.t: Exobiopharma came to Bitz for a visual identity that could carry a biopharmaceutical brand from the lab bench to the shelf. The brief called for a system that reads as scientific and trustworthy without slipping into the sterile, interchangeable language so much of the pharma category defaults to.

A bold, all-caps wordmark set in Poppins Bold, paired with a palette that swings between clinical blue and higher-energy accent tones - science and confidence in the same breath. Every touchpoint, from logo construction to packaging and app icon, holds up at pharmacy-shelf scale and screen scale.
Poppins Bold in uppercase carries every headline and the wordmark itself. Poppins Regular handles body copy, keeping longer scientific and regulatory text easy to read at any size.
Designing Exobiopharma meant giving a science-led brand a face it could trust - clear enough for a pharmacy shelf, credible enough for a clinical setting.

title: Marsleaders
blurb: Identity, NFT artwork direction and website for Marsleaders - a virtual world where political figures compete, with a mark that is solid and authoritative yet playful and planetary.

sections.t: Marsleaders is a virtual world where anything is possible - explore new frontiers, test your entrepreneurship and build a virtual existence. The rewards are real: holding NFTs earns incentives redeemed in the real world.

Four logo variants for different platforms. The design reflects interactions between political figures, giving the mark a solid, authoritative character, balanced by a planetary element for a more playful, dynamic touch. Patch-like shapes echo the badges on the characters' jackets.
The primary logo features a planet within a circle, encircled by the project name and three stars - elements used consistently across every variation.
Multiple character variations were sketched, refined and generated. Artwork by Xesus Bobomb. Custom animated Discord emoji strengthen the identity.
A website with clean aesthetics and smooth functionality - thoughtful UI with seamless UX for clarity, flow and consistency.

title: BRACE
blurb: Complete branding for BRACE, an EV charging brand - identity, 3D, motion and print that give form to energy, movement and cleaner roads ahead.

sections.t: An EV charger is crucial infrastructure for the growing number of electric vehicle owners worldwide. We crafted every aspect of the branding to reflect the brand's mission - advancing EV charging, driving innovation and bracing for a greener future.
A clear breakdown of the colours, typography, logotype and logo architecture that shape the identity.
Supporting materials developed throughout the process - social posts, cards, stationery, apparel and environmental applications.
Client BRACE. Director Luka Gabidzashvili. 3D artist Giorgi Berianidze. Graphic designers DAVE and Mariam Ninoshvili.

title: Motorola Transistor Concept
blurb: A hobbyist 3D project - the iconic Motorola transistor radio reimagined, from model and materials to lighting and animation.

sections.t: A reimagined retro-style radio receiver inspired by the iconic Motorola Transistor. From the 3D model to the carefully selected materials and lighting, every detail was designed to perfection.
The project preserves the retro charm of the classic receiver while introducing modern updates - a piece that captures the past and looks at home in the present.
An animation that highlights every detail and shows how the receiver works.
Multiple colour versions - black, silver, teal, orange and dark.

title: Cerebro
blurb: Logo and visual identity for Cerebro, a digital marketing agency - the human brain blended with the digital world.

sections.t: A logo and visual identity that captures the essence of the human brain and blends it with the digital world.
Logo, pattern and typography working together - a mark for pre-defined cases and a pattern built to stand out.
A logo versatile enough for horizontal and vertical use, with multiple colour-changing versions for any setting.
An expanded gamut that keeps the current active colour while adding tones, gradations and additional colours.

title: Lisi Drive
blurb: Signage, exterior and packaging design for the Lisi Drive development - from lightbox signposts to 3D day and night facade renders.

sections.t: Sign design developed with lightbox blocks, logo and arrow rendering.
Beautified facade with decorations and glass band stickers; 3D rendering with day and night views.
Lisi Drive packaging designs with a unique and eye-catching appeal.

title: Credo Bank
blurb: UI/UX for Credo Bank's Decreasing SMART Deposit calculator - a 3-step flow for desktop and mobile that lets users customise and see their result instantly.

sections.t: Intuitive 3-step SMART Deposit calculator for the Credo Bank website, enabling users to easily input and calculate deposit amounts.
A customisable 3-step design with an adjustable table for the desired deposit amount.
Redesigned Credo Bank's Internet Banking login for individuals and legal entities, in shapes and colours that follow the bank's brand guidelines.

title: RoyalPixels

sections.t: Beginner-friendly and professional motion designer-friendly video transitions.
NEO-futuristic style with viewfinders, HUD UI and tech vectors.
A set of symbols and compositions in diverse futuristic styles.

title: ANBANTKEBA

sections.t: The artistic and cognitive value of the Anbantkeba graphic series, showcasing Nuskhuri, Asomtavruli and Mkhedruli through 36 compositions.
Postero's digital and printed materials elevated with high-quality photography and poster design.
The Postero logo was designed and produced.

title: E-Space

sections.t: A simple video instruction showing how to charge an electric car through the new E-Space app.
A guide to making money with chargers - a graphic video for the new business module.
